# TheTaxCalc

> Free 2026 tax calculators for US taxpayers. 64 calculators covering all 50 states. No sign-up required.

TheTaxCalc provides free, accurate tax calculators for federal, state, and local taxes. All calculations are based on 2026 IRS tax brackets and state tax rates. Author: Rachel Mitchell, CPA.

## Calculators

- [Paycheck Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/paycheck-calculator): Calculate take-home pay after federal, FICA, and state taxes. Supports all 50 states with 401(k) and HSA deductions.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/sales-tax-calculator): Calculate combined state + local sales tax for any US state. Includes reverse tax calculator and car sales tax.
- [Lottery Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/lottery-tax-calculator): How much tax on lottery winnings? Federal + state taxes, lump sum vs annuity comparison.
- [Self-Employment Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/self-employment-tax-calculator): 15.3% SE tax on 92.35% of net income, half deduction, quarterly estimates.
- [Property Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/property-tax-calculator): Compare property taxes across all 50 states. Annual cost by state and home value.
- [Bonus Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/bonus-tax-calculator): How much tax on your bonus? Compare 22% flat rate vs aggregate method.
- [Capital Gains Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/capital-gains-calculator): Short-term and long-term capital gains tax rates (0%/15%/20% + 3.8% NIIT).
- [401(k) Retirement Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/401k-retirement-calculator): Projected balance with employer match and compound annual growth.
- [IRS Withholding Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/irs-withholding-calculator): W-4 optimization tool. Calculate recommended federal withholding per paycheck.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/mortgage-calculator): Monthly payment, amortization schedule, and extra payment savings.
- [Employee Cost Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/employee-cost-calculator): True cost of hiring — salary + employer FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and benefits.
- [Overtime Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/overtime-tax-calculator): Calculate savings under the 2025–2028 OT tax exemption law.
- [Tax Refund Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/tax-refund-calculator): Estimate your federal and state tax refund.
- [Relocation Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/relocation-calculator): Compare equivalent salary between states.
- [Paycheck Difference Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/paycheck-difference-calculator): Compare take-home pay between two states.
- [Salary Comparison Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/salary-comparison-calculator): Compare after-tax pay by state.
- [Job Offer Comparison Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/job-offer-comparison-calculator): Compare two or more job offers after taxes.
- [Home Sale Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/home-sale-tax-calculator): Capital gains on home sales with $250K/$500K exclusion.

## State Tax Calculators

- [California Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/california-tax-calculator): 1%–13.3% progressive income tax
- [Texas Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/texas-tax-calculator): 0% income tax, high property tax
- [Florida Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/florida-tax-calculator): 0% income tax, homestead exemption
- [New York Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/new-york-tax-calculator): 4%–10.9% + NYC tax
- [Illinois Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/illinois-tax-calculator): 4.95% flat tax
- [Washington Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/washington-tax-calculator): 0% income tax, high sales tax
- [Georgia Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/georgia-tax-calculator): 5.49% flat tax
- [Arizona Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/arizona-tax-calculator): 2.5% flat tax
- [Pennsylvania Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/pennsylvania-tax-calculator): 3.07% flat tax
- [North Carolina Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/north-carolina-tax-calculator): 4.5% flat tax
